svg.title: Employee documents and contracts — SoftTrack web design mockup (#253)
svg.desc: Contracts, copies of IDs and certificates are kept per person in a shared drive whose permissions nobody is sure of. Documents on a person have a category, a title and optional issue and expiry dates, go through the attachment pipeline as it is, are read by the person and HR admins and nobody else, and remind before they expire.

svg.text: Done when documents can be added to a person with a category, a title and optional issue and expiry dates, through the existing attachment pipeline; they are read by the person
and HR admins and nobody else; both can upload; expiry reminds the person and HR thirty days ahead and on the day; HR can publish a policy and see who has not
acknowledged it; documents stay with HR when somebody leaves, under a retention period; and every download is logged.
